Round Trip
Arrival is the same as Departure. Enter the TOTAL flight time — climb and descent are computed and the remainder becomes the time in the training area, so the sortie comes to exactly the time you asked for.
Fuel uses 75% cruise GPH × duration. No climb/descent computation.
Blank = AFM cruise table at each leg's altitude & OAT
Approach route — Jeppesen VRMG 12-1 / 12-2
Fix Note MT ° Dist NM Alt ft
Blank Alt = planned altitude. First leg starts at the training area.
Sequence: take-off → TOC → training area → approach fixes → MAP → circuit → land. Enter the TOTAL flight time — climb, approach legs and circuit are computed and the remainder is the time in the training area. Each leg gets its own wind and OAT, interpolated between the surface and 5000 ft values at that leg's mean altitude, so TAS, WCA, MH and GS are worked per leg.
